name: Ensuring Technology
summary: Ensuring Technology develops multidimensional tactile sensors, flexible electronic skin and wearable capture terminals for embodied intelligence. Its hardware measures contact and force and synchronizes tactile signals with hand motion for robot training and teleoperation.
